title: Build the tree-equal push skip (R61/R62) and run mutation_report on lane PRs, each with a test first
why: Equal-tree pushes rerun CI for nothing, and the mutation report never runs on a lane PR, so a weak test passes unseen.
source: Lane merge-flow-after-anthropic (session_013NEJL2oxYMVKoXseeKacVG), R42 part 2 fix-after, via the coordinator 15:36 CST Nov 13; read at main 59da758a3. Item (e).
note: Filed 15:36 CST Nov 13. Files: .github/workflows/checks.yml (push job gating) and actions/mutation-report. Retro read that the tree-equal push skip is not built and that mutation_report never runs on a lane PR; the lane did not measure it. Fix: a push run whose tree equals an already-green run's tree is a pass; mutation_report runs on lane PRs; each with a test first. Overlaps: push-skip-proven-tree, push-skip-partial-run-record, same-pr-tree-equal-record, mutation-report-child-adoption (check before a lane starts). A CI change: ci-hygiene skill applies. Past rulings not checked.
